svg.title: Editable ensemble-centered ECD/VCD graphical abstract
svg.desc: Original molecule-independent conceptual vector diagram. All landscapes and spectra are schematic; no molecular structures or embedded raster images.
svg.text: Conformational search: strategies and candidate selection
Complementary routes to a representative low-energy ensemble
Low-cost evaluation: MMFF / semiempirical methods / GFNn-xTB
Alternative discussed in the review: direct calculations and averaging over MD snapshots
Schematic routes; sampling strategies can be combined. No specific molecular structure or simulation dataset.
